why: handleSubmit adds the to-do and clears the box, but it never calls e.preventDefault(): the browser's own form submit reloads the page, so the new to-do flashes and the list is back to the three starting items. onSubmit, setTodos and setText('') are all there; the form still does not add a to-do that stays.

step.title: Add a to-do on submit
step.instructions: In src/TodoApp.jsx, give the form onSubmit={handleSubmit}. In handleSubmit, call e.preventDefault(), add the new to-do with setTodos([...todos, { id: Date.now(), text }]) and clear the box with setText('').
hints: A form submit reloads the page unless the handler stops it.
common_mistakes: Leaving out e.preventDefault(), so the page reloads and the new to-do is lost.
